decisions.title: Make the unified playlist listening loop a first-class Resonant product direction
decisions.problem: DJs must switch among local files, SoundCloud, Spotify and other apps to audition one set playlist, while existing plans treated player, playlists and mixes as mostly separate surfaces
alternatives: Keep the quick folder-to-mix tool and PlaylistIQ separate
Offer cloud storage/playback without native playlist workflow
Unify library, playlist editing, continuous listening, eligible-file download and later mixes behind independent contracts
decisions.criteria: Reduced context switching, editable auditable playlists, clear source capability boundaries, low-frequency download UX and preserved component independence
decisions.rationale: A single assemble-listen-revise-take-away loop connects the already built local capabilities to a recurring DJ set-preparation job
decisions.consequences: Native/manual and PlaylistIQ-assisted playlists plus continuous in-app playback enter the north star. Download playlist files is a secondary ellipsis-menu job for owned/download-authorized audio with manifest and omissions, distinct from JSON export and mix rendering
decisions.scope: Accepted product and UX direction only; no provider integration, cloud implementation, upload, remote audio, deployment, spending or gate waiver
supersedes: The narrow product framing of only a quick mix utility beside a separate prompt-to-playlist tool
decisions.reopen_condition: User research rejects the workflow, provider capabilities prevent a useful continuous experience, rights review blocks the intended source mix, or measured cost/size/recovery is unacceptable
